published.title: The Fence Moves West
published.dek: The United States has broadened its AI chip export restrictions beyond China to several Middle Eastern countries. Nvidia’s A100 and H100 now need licenses there. Nothing was banned — which is exactly the point.
published.author: Propagation House
published.summary: The US broadened AI chip export restrictions beyond China to several Middle Eastern countries; Nvidia’s A100 and H100 now require licenses. A licensing regime, not a ban — every shipment becomes a decision.

published.title: The Music Sues Back
published.dek: Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell are suing Anthropic over training and output of copyrighted songs — and named CEO Dario Amodei personally. The third music action in six weeks is a campaign, not a coincidence.
published.author: Propagation House
published.summary: Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell sued Anthropic, naming Amodei and Mann personally. The metadata-stripping count is the sharpest tool; the settlement era’s peace is being tested.

published.title: The Money Pauses
published.summary: Nvidia has stepped back from parts of its AI cloud financing program — the one that traded credit support for a cut of customers’ revenue — after its own lawyers reportedly flagged the antitrust exposure. Thirty-six billion dollars in commitments just met a regulator-shaped wall.
published.author: Propagation House

published.title: The Standard Gets a Body
published.summary: Anthropic’s Model Hardware Standard wants to do for lab robots and instruments what MCP did for software tools: one interface, any model, any arm. The physical world is about to get a driver layer — and whoever writes it sets the defaults.
published.author: Propagation House

published.title: The Raise That Is a Cut
published.dek: Anthropic is permanently raising Claude Code’s weekly limits by 25 percent. The temporary boost it replaces was 50. The arithmetic of abundance, explained.
published.author: Propagation House
published.summary: Claude Code weekly limits go permanently +25% over baseline on Sept 14 — but the expiring promo was +50%, so the raise is a net ~17% cut from today’s allowance. Rationing by expiration.

published.title: The First Name in Images Retires
published.dek: The official DALL·E GPT quietly disappeared from ChatGPT on Saturday. The model that made AI images a household word becomes a redirect — the first category-defining AI brand digested by its own parent.
published.author: Propagation House
published.summary: OpenAI retired the official DALL·E GPT from ChatGPT on Aug 30; image generation continues via ChatGPT Images. The category didn’t die — it was digested into a mode.
